services and reserves the right to offer Full Time engagement accordingly.  For part 
time engagement  reservation policies shall not be applicable.   Candidates shall be 
preferred  if any apply for Full Time. 
 
 
 
General instructions:  
1. The recruitment will be purely on contractual basis and selected candidates will have 
no claim for    regularization of the service in the hospital.  
2. The selected candidates will have to join immediately / within 15 days from the date of 
receipt of the letter for offer of Appointment. 
3. Candidates must be registered with Karnataka Medial Council or MCI before joining the 
post. 
4. Canvassing in any form shall be liable for disqualification.  
5. Hostel accommodation/quarters/uniform/transport allowances will not be provided. 
6. The candidate who is in service should submit “No Objection Certificate” from the 
employer at the time of interview. 
7. No TA/DA will be admissible either for the ‘Walk- in- interview’ or for joining the post. 
8. Candidate seeking reservation benefits for SC/ST/OBC must ensure that they are 
entitled to such reservations as per eligibility prescribed in the Notice.  They should also 
be in possession of the required certificates in the prescribed format in support of their 
claim as stipulated in this Notice.  OBC candidates should ensure that they are in 
possession of valid OBC Certificate issued within the due date by the authority mentioned 
in the format. 
9. The candidate claiming reservation / age relaxation on grounds of belonging to OBC 
should submit the community Certificate in  Annexure ”A” prescribe vide Govt. Of India, 
Department of Personnel and Training OM No.36036/2/2013-Estt (Res); dated 
30.05.2014 failing which the benefit of reservation / relaxation will not be given or their 
application shall be rejected and no request/ correspondence will be entertained. 
Certificates issued in other formats will not be accepted and the candidate will be treated 
as “General Category” for all purpose.   
10. The candidates are advised to bring their application/Bio data and original certificates. 
11. On selection the candidates have to open an SB Account in the State Bank of India at 
any Branches (This is applicable to cases where SB account is not held in State Bank of 
India). 
12. The posts are contractual and the contractual engagement may be terminated/ 
discontinued by either side giving one month prior notice to this effect without 
assigning any reason. 
13. The decision of the Selection Board will be final on all aspects of selection and no further 
correspondence will be entertained under any circumstances. 
14. The Selection is subject to the candidates proving their medical fitness.  
15.  In case of selection, OFFER OF APPOINTMENT will be issued as per requirement.  
16. All the candidates are directed report in the office of the Medical Superintendent ESIC 
Hospital, Peenya, Bengaluru, as per the timing mentioned above. 
 
 
 
 
 
5 | P a g e 
 
 
Terms and conditions applicable for SENIOR RESIDENTS  UNDER THREE YEARS 
RESIDENCY SCHEME on contract basis 
 
1. The number of vacancies may be changed without any prior notice. 
2. No TA/DA will be admissible either for the ‘Walk- in- interview’ or for joining the 
post. 
3. The Competent Authority reserves the right to fill up all or not to fill up any post. 
4. Selected candidates will have no claim for regularization of the service in the hospital 
5. Hostel accommodation/quarters/uniform will not be provided. 
6. The selected candidates will have to join immediately / within 15 days from the date 
of receipt   of the Selection  order. 
7. The selected candidate  for the post of Senior Resident under three-year scheme will 
have to furnish a DD/Bankers Cheque for an amount   of    Rs. 95,000/-         (Rupees 
Ninety-Five Thousand  Only) drawn in favor of ‘ESIC A/c No 1’ payable at  Bengaluru  
towards security deposit.  If the candidate resigns/terminates his/her contract within 
One Year of the commencement of the contract, Rs. 30,000/- (Rupees Thirty thousand  
only)will be appropriated towards administrative cost.   
8. The selected candidate will have to give one month notice prior to his resignation,  
failing which amount of one month’s salary or amount towards the short fall of  one 
month notice period will be paid by the selected candidate. 
9. The selection is subject to the candidates proving their medical fitness & verification 
of Character & Antecedents. 
10. Private practice is strictly not allowed as the selected candidates will be in 
receipt of non-practicing allowance. If found guilty, suitable action as provided under 
the relevant rules shall be   taken. 
 
11. The appointment shall not offer any right or preference for regular 
appointment. 
12. No claim for any service benefit like, PF, Pension, Gratuity, medical 
Allowance, Seniority,      Promotion and leave will be admissible, 
13. Candidates must be registered with Karnataka Medial Council or MCI before 
joining the post. 
14. The candidate who is in Government Service should submit ”No Objection 
Certificate” from the employer at the time of  interview.

are entitled to such reservations as per eligibility prescribed in the Notice.  They 
should also be in possession of the required certificates in the prescribed format in 
support of their claim as stipulated in this Notice.

Certificates issued in other formats will not be accepted and the candidate will be 
treated as “General Category” for all purpose.

certificates. 
18. The candidates who have worked already as a Senior Resident under 3 years 
Central Senior Residency   scheme for 3 years are not eligible for applying for the post. 
19. All the candidates are directed report in the office of the Medical 
Superintendent ESIC Hospital, Peenya, Bengaluru, as per the timing mentioned 
above.

India at any Branches (This is applicable to cases where SB account is not held in 
State Bank of India). 
 
21. The decision of the selection board will be final on all aspects of selection and 
no further correspondence will be entertained under any circumstance.

till regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier and for the Full Time Specialist the 
period of contract will be One year on  contract or  till regular  incumbent joins whichever 
is earlier or extendable up to 3 years  on satisfactory performance and renewal every year.  
2.  Part Time Specialist will not be entitled for any kind of leave or benefits.  
3.  Available on call 24x7 if he/she is drawing emergency call charges.  
4. The Specialist shall be responsible for all cases undergoing treatment under his 
supervision in his discipline 
5.  The selected Specialist must have a professional indemnity policy which should cover 
the period as desired by ESIC. The policy is meant to cover the professional liability falling 
on them as a result of errors and omissions committed by them while rendering 
professional services. The minimum sum assured per annum should be  
a) Rs 30 lakhs: Anesthesiologists, Cardiac Surgeons, Neuro Surgeons, Plastic Surgeons 
etc. 
b) Rs 20 lakhs: for General Surgeons, Gynecologists, Obstetricians etc. 
 c) Rs 10 lakhs: for Physicians, Dentists, Radiologists, Pathologists, Chest 
(Pulmonologists) etc.  
A copy of the Insurance & Premium Receipt must be submitted within 7 days from the 
date of engagement. All eligible and interested candidates may appear for walk-in-
interview along with all the testimonials in original and their one self-attested copy as 
per schedule of “Walk-in-interview” on the date & time mentioned against their respective 
specialty. 
6. The selected candidates will have to furnish a DD/Bankers Cheque for an amount of Rs. 
30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand only) drawn in favour of “ESI Fund Account No. 1”

This advertisement operates on a rolling basis and has been released with intent to hire faculty

Institute. Interested eligible candidates are invited to submit online application /s for these 
faculty positions at IIIT-Allahabad, throughout the year with no specific last date for receipt  of

sizeable set of applications  received till this declared “Cut -off Date”  for a particular

National Importance , established in 1999 , by the Ministry of Education, Government of India. The 
Institute offers B.Tech., M.Tech., M.B.A, PhD, and other programs of contemporary relevance to the 
aspiring learners, in the broad areas of  Information Technology , Electronics and Communication Engg., 
Applied Sciences Management Studies and the associated niche domains.  
IIITA invites ONLINE applications on Rolling Basis , for the posts of Assistant Professor (Grade-I) on 
regular basis and Assistant Professor (Grade -II) on Contract . Individuals having Doctoral degree 
from Institutions/Universities in India and from abroad, fulfilling the eligibility criteria as per Four-Tier-
Flexi Cadre Faculty Structure, with conforming academic credentials, demonstrable high quality research, 
committed leadership in & aptitude for innovative teaching -learning, and propensity towards institutional 
development are encouraged to apply, addressing the needs of the Departments of Information 
Technology, Electronics & Communication Engineering, and Applied Sciences.

Teachers’ Cadre) Act 2019, dated 9th July 2019, the Gazette of India, No. 2289, dated 12th July 
2019, and further direction of Ministry of Education vide Notification F.No. 33 -3/2018-TS.III 
dated 5th Nov 2019, the Institution has been treated as one unit.

Caste/Category/Income certificate issued by the Competent Authority in the prescribed format of

issued.

With reference to the advertisement for Walk-in-Interview uploaded on the NIOS website 
on 23.10.2026 and subsequent Corrigendum on 30.10.2026 for the engagement of 
Consultant (Linguistics) purely on contract basis for the above mentioned languages, it 
is hereby informed that the following amendments are being made in the terms and 
conditions of the said advertisement: 
(i) Age Limit: The prescribed age l imit of below 45 years shall be read as upto 55 
years. Accordingly, candidates upto 55 years of age shall also be considered eligible 
to apply for the said engagement, subject to fulfilment of other prescribed eligibility 
conditions. 
(ii) Mode of Interview: Candidates who are unable to attend the Walk -in-Interview 
physically at NIOS Headquarters, NOIDA, may also appear for the interview through 
Virtual Mode. Such candidates are required to inform NIOS in advance by sending 
an email to recruitmentcell@nios.ac.in, indicating their inability to attend the 
interview physically mentioning genuine reasons , so that necessary arrangements 
can be made for conducting the interview through virtual mode. The email must 
contain the candidate’s Name, Mobile Number, Post Applied for with Language 
and Email Address to enable NIOS to share the virtual interview link with the 
concerned candidate. 
The date and time of the Walk -in-Interview shall remain unchanged,  i.e. 13th 
November, 2026 at 9.00 A.M. onwards. 
All other terms and conditions, including prescribed educational qualifications, 
experience and other eligibility criteria, as mentioned in the original advertisement 
dated 23.10.2026 and subsequent corrigend um dated 30.10.2026, shall remain 
unchanged. 
This corrigendum shall be read as an integral part of the original Walk -in-Interview 
notification and subsequent corrigendum.
